title: GTA 6 on Xbox Series S vs Series X
yt_title: GTA 6 on Series S: 720p 😬 Series S vs Series X explained
description:
Digital Foundry: Xbox Series S runs GTA 6 at about 720p and often drops below 30 fps (around 20 fps in the heaviest scenes), while Series X holds about 1440p at 30 fps; Digital Foundry even suggests another console if you can. If you own the game on Xbox, Xbox Cloud Gaming can stream it, even on Xbox One (check Xbox's cloud gaming requirements). Is the Series S enough?

Sources: https://www.tweaktown.com/news/114779/gta-6-drops-to-720p-and-below-30-fps-on-one-console-gamers-ad https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2026/11/10/grand-theft-auto-6-comes-to-xbox-cloud-gaming-november-19/
